full_prompt_en: A square surreal fine-art image holds a quiet right-facing human profile emerging from layers of cracked blue-gray surface. The pale face sits just right of center. Its eye is closed or deeply lowered beneath a dark lash line; a slender nose, softly parted lips, and rounded chin are modeled with restrained gray-green and muted flesh tones. The expression is inward and still. Much of the head and upper left of the frame disappears into near-black shadow. Across the crown and forehead, irregular slate-blue flakes overlap like aged plaster or thick paint that has dried, fractured, and lifted. Their uneven curled edges cast tiny dark seams. Smaller fragments collect at the temple and cheek, where the hard mineral surface seems to dissolve into softer skin. More pale cracked layers gather below the jaw and around the lower neck, leaving the body largely indistinct. A narrow veil of smoky blue softens the border between the face and the abstract material without erasing the sharp torn rims. On the right, an open field of misty steel blue provides quiet negative space and lets the profile read cleanly. The light is diffuse and cool from the right, touching the bridge of the nose, cheek, lips, and upper flakes. The left side recedes through blue-black half tones into deep shadow. Fine grain, scuffed patches, fissures, and uneven paint thickness give the whole surface a tactile, timeworn quality; the skin is smoother but still painterly rather than glossy. The palette stays close to indigo-black, slate blue, frosted gray, and pale desaturated skin. The tight crop, contemplative downward gaze, and material breaking away into darkness make the image feel like a fragile remembered face suspended between painting and weathered wall.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实艺术图像呈现一张安静的朝右侧脸，从开裂的蓝灰色层面中浮现。浅色面孔位于画面中央偏右，眼睛闭合或深深垂下，深色睫线之下，纤细的鼻梁、微启的嘴唇和圆润下巴以克制的灰绿及低饱和肤色塑造。神情内敛而静止。头部大半和画面左上部隐入近黑色阴影。头顶与额前覆盖着不规则的石板蓝色片层，像厚涂颜料或旧灰泥干燥后开裂、翘起。参差卷曲的边缘投下细小暗缝。更小的碎片聚在太阳穴和颧侧，坚硬的矿物表面仿佛逐渐溶进柔软皮肤。颌下与颈部还围着几层更浅的裂片，身体则基本模糊。薄薄的烟蓝色雾感柔和了面部与抽象物质的交界，但没有抹去撕裂边缘的锐度。右侧一片朦胧钢蓝留白，使侧脸轮廓清楚可读。冷而漫射的光从右侧照来，触及鼻梁、面颊、嘴唇及上方裂片；左侧经蓝黑中间调逐渐退入深影。细颗粒、擦痕、裂纹和不均的颜料厚度，使整体具有可触的陈旧质地；皮肤较平滑，却仍是绘画感而非光亮表面。配色紧守靛黑、石板蓝、霜灰和苍白的低饱和肤色。紧凑裁切、沉思般的垂目与向黑暗中剥落的物质，让图像仿佛一张脆弱的记忆面孔，悬在绘画与风化墙面之间。
style_prompt_en: Use a moody mixed-media fine-art treatment that merges soft realistic modeling with thick, deteriorated paint or plaster texture. Build forms from layered slate blue, blue-black, icy gray, and sparse pale flesh tones. Let cracked sheets, lifted edges, fissures, scuffs, and grain occupy substantial areas, with tiny cast shadows revealing their physical thickness. Place a smoothly modeled focal form against the rough material so the transition feels gradual in some places and sharply torn in others. Illuminate from one cool, diffuse side; fade the opposite side into a dense dark mass, leaving a broad misty opening for breathing room. Keep highlights chalky and restrained, without glossy shine. Use a close crop and asymmetric light-dark balance to create a still, contemplative atmosphere. Preserve both the readable volume beneath the surface and the irregular, tactile relief above it.
style_prompt_zh: 采用阴郁的混合媒介艺术处理，让柔和的写实体积与厚重、风化的颜料或灰泥肌理融合。用石板蓝、蓝黑、冰灰和极少的苍白肤色建立形体。让开裂片层、翘起边缘、裂缝、擦痕与颗粒占据足够面积，细小投影显示材料的实际厚度。把塑造平滑的视觉焦点放在粗糙材质旁，使二者在某些地方缓慢过渡，在另一些地方又像被锐利撕开。以单侧冷漫射光照亮一边，让另一边退入浓重暗部，并留一块雾状空域供画面呼吸。亮部保持粉质和克制，避免光滑反射。近景裁切和不对称的明暗平衡营造静止、沉思的气氛。既保留表层下方可读的体积，也保留表面不规则、可触摸般的浮雕起伏。
theme_en: A downward-looking face emerging from cracked blue-gray layers
theme_zh: 一张垂目侧脸从开裂的蓝灰色层面中浮现
name: Gabriele Viertel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
